This is a mediocre business priced as if it were a high-return compounder. An average return on equity of just 8% and a negative book value per share growth rate over four years prove that capital is not compounding for shareholders. Paying nearly 39 times earnings for 7-8% net margins and flat book value requires a degree of foolish optimism I refuse to engage in.
